name: acf-advisor
description: Advisor + board-of-advisors skills - consult another LLM (with thinking/reasoning mode on) for a single second opinion, OR convene a multi-persona panel hypertailored to a specific decision. Personas synthesized per call from a structured recipe; round count chosen by deliberative judgment. Works against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint; comma-delimited ADVISOR_MODEL declares a multi-model pool. Local-team fallback when no API endpoint is configured (each persona runs as a Claude subagent, no external calls).
